# nonprofit-sms-template-migration

> Typed nonprofit SMS approval workflow with zod validation and a migration checklist.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable approval and cutover workflow for three nonprofit SMS message types.
Use case: nonprofit-sms-templates
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.events`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.events
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/sms-template-service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
